decisive_items: duodenal diverticula, wall thickening with mesenteric edema approximately 25 cm beyond the ligament of Treitz, and mesenteric lymphadenopathy with luminal patency
response.rationale: R4 is the strongest candidate due to the presence of duodenal diverticula and wall thickening with mesenteric edema, which are consistent with diverticulitis. C1 is a close runner-up as it specifically mentions 'duodenal diverticula', localizing the diverticulitis to the duodenum.

rejected.why: family history of ulcerative colitis is not sufficient to support inflammatory bowel disease diagnosis
presence of luminal patency on imaging studies argues against small bowel obstruction
